title: Structural and Functional Characterization of the N-Prenyltransferase DsKabA in Algal Neurotoxin Biosynthesis.
authors: Huang, Wei-Jia; Chen, Sheng-Chia; Chien, I-Weh; Lin, Chia-Hsin; Zhou, Jia-Yi; Guo, Bo-Yan; Chang, San-Chi; Lin, Sheng-Wei; Hsu, Chun-Hua
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文通过晶体结构、对接和MD模拟表征海藻神经毒素合成酶DsKabA的结构与功能，虽以酶为对象但涉及蛋白结构计算建模，可借鉴其结构-机制研究方法。
abstract: Kainic acid (KA) is a neuroactive natural product from the red alga Digenea simplex. Its biosynthesis begins with DsKabA, an N-prenyltransferase that converts l-glutamate and dimethylallyl pyrophosphate into prekainic acid, the first committed intermediate. Here, we combined LC-MS activity assays, X-ray crystallography, SAXS, molecular docking, ITC, MD simulations, and mutagenesis to characterize DsKabA. Product analysis confirmed prekainic acid formation, and kinetic measurements yielded apparent Km values of 1.03 +/- 0.16 muM for DMAPP and 52.25 +/- 1.61 mM for l-Glu. The 2.85 A apo structure revealed open and closed conformations involving the alpha7-loop-alpha8 region near the active site. Docking, ITC, and mutagenesis support Mg2+-dependent donor binding, ordered l-Glu association, and roles for Y403, H406, E407, M114, and M118 in catalysis and prenyl-donor recognition. These findings provide structural and mechanistic insight into the first committed step of KA biosynthesis.
abstract_zh: 海人酸 (kainic acid, KA) 是一种来源于红藻 Digenea simplex 的神经活性天然产物。其生物合成始于 DsKabA，一种 N-异戊烯基转移酶，该酶将 l-谷氨酸和二甲基烯丙基焦磷酸转化为前海人酸 (prekainic acid)，这是第一个关键中间体。在本研究中，我们结合 LC-MS 活性测定、X 射线晶体学、SAXS、分子对接、ITC、MD 模拟和突变分析来表征 DsKabA。产物分析确认了前海人酸的形成，动力学测量得出 DMAPP 的表观 Km 值为 1.03 ± 0.16 μM，l-Glu 的表观 Km 值为 52.25 ± 1.61 mM。2.85 Å 的脱辅基结构揭示了涉及活性位点附近 α7-loop-α8 区域的开放和闭合构象。对接、ITC 和突变分析支持 Mg²⁺ 依赖性供体结合、有序的 l-Glu 结合，以及 Y403、H406、E407、M114 和 M118 在催化和异戊烯基供体识别中的作用。这些发现为 KA 生物合成的第一个关键步骤提供了结构和机制上的见解。
